description: This PHP script serves as a test and integration example for a tracxmlrpc-based issue tracker interface within the TestLink project. It sets up configuration parameters, initializes the interface, and performs operations such as retrieving issue details and checking issue existence, demonstrating plugin use and debugging.

classes.name: tracxmlrpcInterface
classes.description: A class interfacing with the tracxmlrpc issue tracking system for issue retrieval and verification.

classes.name: dBug
classes.description: A debugging utility class for outputting variable dumps.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specified issue ID from the tracxmlrpc interface.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a given bug ID exists within the tracxmlrpc issue tracker.
